content.short: Reactive Network is an event-driven execution layer whose contracts react to events on other chains.
content.description: Reactive Network is an event-driven execution layer where reactive contracts execute in response to events emitted on other EVM chains, with no transaction needed to call them. A contract is standard Solidity: it subscribes to a target address and event signature, and needs no off-chain indexer, polling loop or bot. Contracts persist state across events, so they can react to a sequence instead of a single transaction, and several can be coordinated into multi-step cross-chain processes. The network runs CometBFT consensus with roughly one-second blocks and instant finality, and contracts can verify that a callback originated from it.
